title: Uniqueness of rectifiable representations on an open set
statement:
Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, and O ⊆ U open. For i = 1, 2 let (M_i, θ_i, ξ_i) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple U k M_i θ_i ξ_i. Suppose τ(M₁,θ₁,ξ₁)(ω) = τ(M₂,θ₂,ξ₂)(ω) for every ω ∈ Dᵏ(U) (TestFormOn U k) with tsupport ω ⊆ O, where τ(M,θ,ξ)(ω) = tauAction k M θ ξ ω = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHᵏ. Then:
- Hᵏ((M₁ Δ M₂) ∩ O) = 0, and
- θ₁ = θ₂ and ξ₁ = ξ₂ hold Hᵏ⌞(M₁ ∩ O)-almost everywhere.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U O : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen O → O ⊆ U → ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Set (Eucl P)) (θ₁ θ₂ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ₁ ξ₂ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), IsRectifiableTriple U k M₁ θ₁ ξ₁ → IsRectifiableTriple U k M₂ θ₂ ξ₂ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ O → tauAction k M₁ θ₁ ξ₁ ω = tauAction k M₂ θ₂ ξ₂ ω) → (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) (symmDiff M₁ M₂ ∩ O) = 0 ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M₁ ∩ O)), θ₁ x = θ₂ x ∧ ξ₁ x = ξ₂ x
